name: spellkave_set_movement_default
label: Set Movement Default
description: Author a bundle- or graph-scoped default traversal mode (ADR-0101) — the primitive that makes ordinary walking need ZERO per-edge place_edge_affordance rows (A-1). Validates affordance_template_id (and place_graph_id, when given) both already resolve, then upserts by (bundle_id, place_graph_id, mode_id, affordance_template_id) — re-authoring the SAME scope+mode+template REPLACES bindings_json; a second template in the same scope+mode is a sibling row (AND-join); a distinct mode_id is a third alternative (OR, cheapest-mode charges).

bundle.description: movement_defaults.bundle_id. Omit to fall back to `context.defaultBundle`. ALWAYS the scope owner, even when place_graph_id narrows the row to one graph.

place_graph_id.description: movement_defaults.place_graph_id (default "" — bundle scope, applies to every edge in the bundle with no closer graph default). Set to scope this default to ONE place_graph instead (must already exist in workspace/live/target) — a graph-scoped default beats a bundle-scoped one for edges in that graph (D-2: edge > graph > bundle).

mode_id.description: movement_defaults.mode_id (default "" — the implicit default mode, same open author-chosen vocabulary as spellkave_bind_edge_affordance's mode_id, e.g. "fly"). Rows sharing one (scope, mode_id) AND-join; a distinct mode_id under the same scope is an alternative the kernel OR-picks the cheapest passing one from.

affordance_template_id.description: movement_defaults.affordance_template_id — must already resolve to an authored affordance_templates row (workspace, live, or the active target); this call does not auto-create it.

promptSnippet: Author a bundle/graph-wide default traversal mode (no per-edge rows needed)
promptGuidelines: Author ONE bundle-scoped default (omit place_graph_id) up front for ordinary walking — every edge inherits it unless its own inherit_movement_default is false.
place_graph_id scopes to one graph and wins over a bundle default there (edge > graph > bundle).
mode_id groups AND-joined rows in one mode; give a fly/swim alternative its own mode_id so the kernel treats it as an OR-alternative, not a conflicting AND-join.
Idempotent: re-calling with the same (bundle, place_graph_id, mode_id, affordance_template_id) replaces bindings_json in place.
